package.name: golfcart_aruco_detector
package.description:
ArUco marker detection: images in, rectified corners and per-marker candidate poses out. No map, no TF, no map-frame pose — that is the localizer's job.
Vendored from LCTK (rust/aruco-config, rust/aruco-detector, rust/aruco-locator, ros/aruco_locator_node) and merged into one package. LCTK keeps its own copy for calibration; see docs/roadmaps/3-indoor-d5-detector.md for what was dropped in the merge and why.
